critical_distinctions: SBIC East/Central/West are separate Japanese regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies; none is SBI Holdings or SBI Ripple Asia.
SBI Ripple Asia is the SBI Holdings-Ripple joint venture; SBI Group's disclosed voting interest is 60%. Do not attribute the undisclosed remaining 40% without primary evidence.
The SBI Remit corridors use XRP as a bridge asset; this is stronger evidence of XRP utility than an XRPL-only proof of concept, but no current corridor volumes or XRP inventory are disclosed.
SBI VC Trade's RLUSD listing is a direct Ripple product distribution relationship; it is not proof of RLUSD collateral acceptance at Coinbase Global Exchange.
SBI's Circle relationship is direct and economically material, but Arc is Circle's separate L1; SBI's Arc validator role is not XRP validator activity.
The 2026 tokenized-deposit proof of concept uses XRPL as infrastructure; tokenized bank deposits are not equivalent to XRP being the payment asset.
The SBI Visa Crypto Card's XRP rewards and SBI VC Trade account counts are retail distribution indicators, not institutional XRP custody, collateral balances or market depth.
